parts.label: Brooch pin and clasp assembly
parts.description: Rear fastening hardware visible along the right side and through openings in the brooch body.

parts.label: Harp string wires
parts.description: Set of narrow metal wires spanning between the upper neck and lower frame, treated as one manufactured string assembly.

parts.label: Main harp body and frame
parts.description: Large formed metal component comprising the curved outer arm, top neck, lower circular frame, and triangular soundboard.

parts.label: Raised leaf ornaments
parts.description: Pair of applied dark metal leaf-like decorative elements mounted near the center of the harp body.

parts.label: Decorative fastener studs
parts.description: Round-headed studs fixed across the upper neck of the harp body, grouped as one repeated hardware component set.

parts.label: Engraved flourish
parts.description: Dark incised curving decorative line on the triangular soundboard surface.
